verse.verse_3: And what will make you know what Al-Qari`ah is
verse.verse_4: It is a Day whereon mankind will be like moths scattered about.
verse.verse_5: And the mountains will be like wool, carded.
verse.verse_6: Then as for him whose Balance will be heavy,
verse.verse_7: He will live a pleasant life.
verse.verse_8: But as for him whose Balance will be light,
verse.verse_10: And what will make you know what it is
